summary: This page presents a Property Portfolio overview featuring six strategically located assets in China (Xining Huayuan, Beijing Wanliu, Dalian Jinsanjiao, Chengdu Konggang, Hefei Mengchenglu, and Hefei Changjiangxilu) with a total gross floor area of 311,691 sqm.
